title: Classic Meatloaf
description: A tender, well-seasoned meatloaf with a tangy brown sugar and ketchup glaze. Leftovers make excellent sandwiches.
equipment: Rimmed baking sheet lined with foil

image.alt: Slices of glazed meatloaf with mashed potatoes

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 350F oven}. Cook the onion in the oil in the skillet over medium heat until soft, {time 6 min}, add the garlic for {time 1 min}, and let cool a little.

In a large bowl, soak the breadcrumbs in the milk and eggs for {time 5 min}. Add the beef, cooked onion, Worcestershire, mustard, thyme, salt and pepper and mix gently with your hands just until combined.
Shape the mixture into a loaf about {len 9x5 in} on the lined baking sheet. A free-form loaf browns better than one in a pan.
Stir the ketchup, brown sugar and vinegar together and spread half over the loaf. Bake for {time 40 min}.
Spread on the rest of the glaze and bake until the center reads {temp 160F internal}, {time 15-25 min}. Rest for {time 10 min} before slicing.

notes: Mix with a light hand; overworking the meat makes a dense, tough loaf.
Wrapped slices freeze well for 3 months.
